question: What will be the percentage change in the Nikkei 225 index (^N225 on Yahoo Finance) from the close on 2026-08-21 to the close on 2026-09-12?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to 100 x (close on 2026-09-12 / close on 2026-08-21 - 1), using daily closes of ^N225 on Yahoo Finance. If there is no close on 2026-09-12, the last close before it is used.
research:
# Nikkei 225 (^N225): research for August 21 to September 12, 2026

Note: I couldn't load any web pages directly because every fetch was refused by the proxy. Everything below comes from search-result summaries. I left out anything dated after 2026-08-22.

## 1. Resolution source
- I couldn't load the Yahoo Finance ^N225 history page. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/%5EN225/)
- 2026-08-21: CNBC reported the Nikkei 225 closed at **66,016.36**, down 0.30%. This is the baseline. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/20/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)
- 2026-08-20: a local market report gave the close as 66,216.79, up 1.36%. That fits with the August 21 figure. [note.com](https://note.com/hirokimiyano/n/n6b0ba82f04f8?hl=en)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet; it depends on 15 sessions that haven't happened.
- The index is about 7% below its June high and about 4.6% below its August 17 close (see 3 and 4).

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-21: the Nikkei fell 3.9% (2,697 points) for the week of Aug 17-21. Reports blamed rising long-term interest rates in Japan and the US, uncertainty in the Middle East, and expectations of an early Bank of Japan (BOJ) rate hike. [BigGo Finance](https://finance.biggo.com/news/4d1700cc-458e-481a-8a2d-a600ab13fc57)
- 2026-08-21: the next-week previews focused on the US PCE inflation data, Nvidia's earnings and the Fed's Jackson Hole meeting. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/21/stock-market-next-week-outlook-for-aug-24-28-2026.html)
- Around 2026-08-21: one preview called the final week of August a "battle for 160 yen" against the dollar, driven by Jackson Hole and a speech by a BOJ deputy governor. [note.com](https://note.com/hirokimiyano/n/ncf26c2817dcd?hl=en)
- 2026-08-17: the Nikkei closed at 69,220.25, up 0.74%, its fifth straight gain, while the broader TOPIX fell 0.31%. Gains were concentrated in AI and chip stocks, and decliners outnumbered advancers 885 to 626. [N1 note](https://note.com/n1_news/n/n4166341f0d53?hl=en)
- From the Aug 17 and Aug 20 closes, the Aug 19 close works out to roughly 65,330. That is a drop of about 5.6% in two sessions (my calculation).
- 2026-08-13: closed at 68,308.59, up 1.16%. 2026-08-07: closed at 65,606.71. [note.com](https://note.com/hirokimiyano/n/n6d6adf7ab2f9?hl=en), [Xinhua](https://english.news.cn/20260807/dcefea1cb363485bb2f90d67524a1b05/c.html)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026-06-19: record close of 71,250.06. [Nippon.com/Jiji](https://www.nippon.com/en/news/yjj2026061900882/)
- 2026-06-03: the index first went above 68,000. 2026-05-13: first close above 63,000. 2026-04-23: first went above 60,000 intraday. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/6/3/japans-stock-market-hits-new-record-as-ai-boom-gathers-steam), [Xinhua](https://english.news.cn/20260513/2157b32e9c0949f3a9c99c4e89894675/c.html), [Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/04/23/markets/nikkei-record/)
- Trend: a strong rally into June, then choppy trading between about 65,000 and 69,000 from June to August.
- Typical move size (my estimate, not from a source):
  - 2026 has seen daily moves of 1-3%, which suggests annualized volatility of roughly 22-28%.
  - Over 15 sessions, that implies a one-standard-deviation move of about ±5.5-7%.
  - Over the long run, 3-week Nikkei changes have a standard deviation of about 4-5%, with a slightly positive median.
- StoneX found the Nikkei's median daily high-low range is 1.46% on the trading day after a Fed speech. [StoneX](https://www.stonex.com/en-gb/news-and-analysis/jackson-hole-returns-nikkei-225-and-nasdaq-100-volatility-in-focus/)

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no prediction market on the Nikkei's change over this specific window.
- 2026-08-11 snapshot: Kalshi's "Nikkei at least ¥73,000 in 2026" contract was at about 51¢, with no trading volume. [SimpleFunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/odds/nikkei)
- Kalshi lists hourly Nikkei contracts (ticker KXNKY) that settle on the Pyth JP225 price, but I couldn't see their prices. [Kalshi](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxnky/nky-hourly/kxnky-26sep0702)
- Polymarket and Kalshi both have markets on the September 17-18 BOJ decision. [PredictionHunt](https://www.predictionhunt.com/odds/bank-of-japan-rate-decision-in-september/29088)
- I found no analyst target ranges for the Nikkei in early September.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Late August: a speech by a BOJ deputy governor that bears on rate-hike timing, with the yen near 160 per dollar. [note.com](https://note.com/hirokimiyano/n/ncf26c2817dcd?hl=en)
- 2026-08-26: Nvidia earnings, a key driver for Japan's AI and chip heavyweights (Advantest, Tokyo Electron, SoftBank Group). [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/21/stock-market-next-week-outlook-for-aug-24-28-2026.html)
- Late August: US PCE inflation data.
- Aug 27-29: Jackson Hole symposium, with Fed Chair Warsh's keynote on Aug 28. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/21/stock-market-next-week-outlook-for-aug-24-28-2026.html)
- Around Aug 31: Japanese July industrial production and retail sales.
- Early September: Japan's Q2 GDP revision, the BOJ Tankan-related data and Japanese wage data, plus the US jobs report (expected Sep 4 under the usual schedule).
- 2026-09-11: the quarterly futures and options settlement (SQ, the second Friday of September), which can make the resolution-day close more volatile.
- After the window: the FOMC (mid-September) and the BOJ meeting (Sep 17-18). Market positioning ahead of both, plus Middle East and oil risk, could move the index during the window.
